verdict.rationale: PostHog ships a built-in AI assistant (PostHog AI) living in a chat sidebar and inline UI entry points that can be delegated tasks in plain English — it queries data, builds insights/dashboards/surveys/alerts/flags, and even kicks off coding tasks that produce PRs — with parallel access via Slack bot and Desktop app. However, a hands-on community report describes concrete failures: the assistant incorrectly claimed cohorts can't use SQL queries (a supported feature) and severely degraded local performance after a couple of prompts, contradicting the polished vendor narrative. Missing for 10: independent corroboration beyond one mixed community report, and clarity on how consistently task delegation (vs. simple Q&A) succeeds in practice.
